intuition: If the right neighbor is larger, some peak must exist to the right; otherwise one exists at or to the left.

brute_force.approach: Check each index against its neighbors and return any local maximum.

optimal.approach: Binary-search the rising or falling side by comparing adjacent values.

edge_cases: A one-element array has peak index zero.
Either endpoint can be a peak.
Multiple peaks are valid; verify the returned index locally.
